key_idea: Construct a signed adjacency matrix for the hypercube whose eigenvalues are exactly ±√n, then apply Cauchy interlacing to bound the maximum degree of any large induced subgraph.
reason: This is a quintessential 'book proof' that resolves a major three-decade-old conjecture in Boolean complexity using under two pages of elementary linear algebra. The ingenious yet trivial-to-verify construction of the signed adjacency matrix elegantly bypasses all combinatorial difficulties.
recognized: Hao Huang's proof of the Sensitivity Conjecture (2019)
